notes: Matches the canonical definite-plural copular shape (GroupOf + the PartOf distributive rule at 1.0/0.9, tense inside the consequent, no QuantifierPhrase since no quantifier word), and 'overwhelming' is correctly kept as a predicative adjective rather than lemmatized to the verb. 'at the market' is rendered with the static LocatedIn head whose examples all use 'in', so the surface preposition is not preserved, though the where-a-THING-is rule appears to license it.
